_note: Principal parts, for generating the three options behind each gap in the conditionals game. Regular verbs are NOT listed — build_conditionals_game.py derives them (want/wanted/wanted, stop/stopped/stopped, carry/carried/carried). Only verbs whose past or participle cannot be derived by rule belong here. Adding a regular verb is harmless but pointless.
_doubling: Verbs whose final consonant doubles before -ed. Not derivable from spelling alone — 'stop' doubles, 'visit' does not, and both are consonant-vowel-consonant in the stressed syllable only for the first.
_note_travel: travel and cancel double in British English (travelled, cancelled) and not in American. British is used throughout, matching Cambridge.
_phrasal: Multi-word verbs conjugate on the FIRST word: wake up -> woke up -> woken up. The builder splits on the space and looks up the head.
_negatives: A gap may hold a negative — 'don't get', 'wouldn't have happened'. The builder detects the negative, conjugates the positive stem, and reapplies it, so the three options stay negative: don't get / didn't get / hadn't got.
